title: Close-approach probe: four A pairs at rest, initial separation 1.0, T=2
pitch: No current paper covers pair separations below 2.0. P-0032 stops at 2.0 and its own law closes a pair to about 0.7 within 0.6. Four isolated A pairs at rest, each at separation 1.0, pair centres 5 apart, tracked to T=2 (2000 samples). The question is what contact does: follows K/r^2.5, softens, bounces or merges. Pre-registered falsifier: the unclamped P-0026 law predicts all four pairs to RMSE/L 0.02 or better through T=2. A miss marks the contact gap and is reported as a measurement first; claims follow.
